title: Aureline M5 review pack record
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for one declarative review-pack record. Names the object class, its review-pack association, the pack version, the content digest, the scope selectors, the evaluator identity, and the pack freshness / invalidation state (pack fresh, stale pack, partial scope, slice omitted, pack invalid) so a pack is never anonymous and a stale pack never looks current. Downstream review detail, the review-pack summary, merge-readiness, the AI review panel, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a pack's meaning by hand. Raw paths, raw glob bodies, raw command lines, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
